# The Lattice
For as long as the sector has been charted, six black pillars have stood on six islands of deck plating around the spot where Caelestinus Central was later built. They were already old when Nanotrasen's first scouts found them. Their glyphs matched no alphabet, they drew no power anyone could measure, and nothing anyone tried would mark them. The surveys logged them as relics and moved on.
When Kyphrus collapsed, the pillars woke.
Their glyphs lit, a field rose around each one, and the [textlink="Unmooring" link="WFLoreUnmooring"] stopped at the edge of their reach. Whoever built them knew this would happen. They built them for it. Today they are called the [color=#d070ff]Lattice[/color], and every life in the sector depends on them.
## The anchors
The six primary anchors stand on the corners of a perfect hexagon around the sector's heart: [bold]Alpha[/bold], [bold]Beta[/bold], [bold]Gamma[/bold], [bold]Delta[/bold], [bold]Epsilon[/bold] and [bold]Zeta[/bold]. Each wears different glyphs. Each sits inside a violet shield that looks uncomfortably like the field a Scion raises at the end of its song, and no ordinary gun has ever brought one down.
Nobody can build a primary anchor. Nobody has worked out how.
## The drones
The sector's drones were the Lattice's maintenance crews. Near a working anchor they still serve it: attack an anchor and they come out of the dark to defend it.
Out past the anchors' reach, or around an anchor that has failed, they lost whatever was telling them what to do. They read every hull as a fault in reality and try to correct it. That is why the drone zones on every scope line up with the edges of the Lattice's hold, and why there are more drones the further out a ship flies.
## Breaches
An anchor can be destroyed. It takes a fleet, and it has happened. When one falls the whole sector hears it, the bands slide inward on its side, and [textlink="Kyphrus" link="WFLoreCollapse"] looks worse in every viewport: the disk stutters, turns violet, and grows a second image that turns the wrong way.
## Relay anchors
Exotic matter from the deep bands can be built into a [bold]relay anchor[/bold]: a small copy of the real thing that holds a little moored space around a parked hull. Prospectors use them to push the frontier outward. [textlink="The Choir" link="WFLoreChoir"] uses them as target practice.
